anchors.name: `S85-MU-BC-OBLIGATION-I-DERIV` (main deriv gate)
anchors.source_context_30_lines:
951: **Hypothesis**: IF upstream `S85-MU-BC-OBLIGATION-I-DERIV` lands a "12" exponent via any of the three V.2 routes (heat-kernel, zeta-at-interior, rep-theoretic), THEN the framework derives y_t, m_W, and mu_BC(μ)-flow from first principles and tests them against PDG precision. IF all three V.2 routes FAIL, gate runs in FALLBACK mode with accommodated `mu_BC = 188.185 GeV` (S84 W9b-105 CUBIC-OMITTED-C2) and SCHEME-DEP flag per W4-48.
